title.zh: 变更拉乌尼翁省与本格特省边界的法案，使加利亚诺 Rancheria 划入拉乌尼翁省、迪斯迪斯 Rancheria 划入本格特省
title.en: AN ACT CHANGING THE BOUNDARIES OF THE PROVINCES OF LA UNION AND BENGUET SO THAT THE RANCHERIA OF GALIANO SHALL BE INCLUDED IN THE PROVINCE OF LA UNION, AND THE RANCHERIA OF DISDIS SHALL BE INCLUDED IN THE PROVINCE OF BENGUET.
title.orig: AN ACT CHANGING THE BOUNDARIES OF THE PROVINCES OF LA UNION AND BENGUET SO THAT THE RANCHERIA OF GALIANO SHALL BE INCLUDED IN THE PROVINCE OF LA UNION, AND THE RANCHERIA OF DISDIS SHALL BE INCLUDED IN THE PROVINCE OF BENGUET.
title.vi: Đạo luật thay đổi ranh giới giữa hai tỉnh La Union và Benguet để đưa rancheria Galiano vào tỉnh La Union và rancheria Disdis vào tỉnh Benguet
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนแปลงเขตแดนระหว่างจังหวัดลาอูนียงกับจังหวัดเบงเกตเพื่อรวมแรนเชเรียกาเลียโนเข้ากับจังหวัดลาอูนียงและแรนเชเรียดิสดิสเข้ากับจังหวัดเบงเกต
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah batas antara Provinsi La Union dan Provinsi Benguet sehingga rancheria Galiano dimasukkan ke dalam Provinsi La Union dan rancheria Disdis dimasukkan ke dalam Provinsi Benguet
title.ms: Akta mengubah sempadan antara Wilayah La Union dan Wilayah Benguet supaya Rancheria Galiano dimasukkan ke dalam Wilayah La Union dan Rancheria Disdis dimasukkan ke dalam Wilayah Benguet

source.name: The LawPhil Project — Arellano Law Foundation

text.en:
The existing boundary line separating the Provinces of La Union and Benguet between Mount
Lusen on the south and Mount Bimmaka on the north is hereby abolished, and a new boundary is hereby
established between these points extending in a straight line from the highest point of Mount Lusen in a
northwesterly direction to the highest point of the Cuesta Santo Domingo, and from this point in a straight
line to the highest point on Mount Bimmaka, so that the rancheria of Galiano shall be included in the
Province of La Union, and the rancheria of Disdis shall be included in the Province of Benguet.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, March 5, 1903.
